findings.title: Include tick-tier families in completeness evidence
findings.description: `coverage_reads()` visits only `entry.history`, omitting both products’ configured `tbbo` tiers. Consequently, `_family_evidence()` never checks or names their incomplete sessions, despite D6 requiring every family. An already-failing health baseline can remain unchanged while these omissions produce no exit-rule failure. Include each configured tier’s range and add a regression test for an unaccounted-for tick-tier session.

findings.title: Only exempt provider holes on provider-missing days
findings.description:
Every `provider_hole` session is skipped regardless of its condition. The existing `tick_status.caught_up()` contract exempts holes only when a constituent day is provider-`missing`; D6 requires the same distinction. A hole on an `available` day therefore remains not caught up but disappears from this report without failing.

Executing the extracted report function with `caught_up=False` and an available-day provider hole returned `SessionReport(lines=[], failures=[])`. Check the qualifying provider condition before exempting the session, and test both qualifying and nonqualifying holes.
